headline: HC freezes S Alam Group’s 81.92% shares in Islami Bank
summary: The High Court ordered the freeze for three months on allegations that the shares were illegally consolidated and controlled by the group.
details: The High Court has ordered the authorities to freeze 81.92 percent of S Alam Group’s shares in Islami Bank Bangladesh for three months.
The order comes amid allegations that the group illegally consolidated and controlled the bank's shares through 24 different companies.
A bench of Justice KM Kamrul Kader and Justice Md Lutfor Rahman issued the rule after a writ petition was filed by the Islamic Economic Research Bureau (IERB).
According to the Bank Company Act 1991, a single group or family cannot hold more than 10 percent of the shares of a bank.
The petition alleges that 24 companies linked to S Alam Group held a combined stake of 81.92 percent, violating sections 14A and 14B of the law.
The court has questioned why the Bangladesh Bank’s inaction in preventing this concentration of shares should not be declared illegal.
The court also questioned why necessary steps should not be taken to forfeit the shares under section 14A (3) of the law.

headline: 70-year-old woman dies after being hit by state minister’s car in Bogura
summary: The victim, Firoza Begum, died while undergoing treatment at a hospital. State Minister Abdul Bari and his wife also sustained injuries in the crash.
details: A 70-year-old woman, identified as Firoza Begum, died after being hit by a car carrying State Minister for Public Administration and Food Abdul Bari and his wife in Bogura’s Shibganj upazila.
The accident occurred around 9:00 am yesterday morning on the Bogura-Joypurhat road in Gopinathpur village as the minister was travelling from Dhaka to Joypurhat.
According to the victim's nephew, Firoza Begum was crossing the road after a police protocol van had passed when she was hit by the minister's SUV.
Firoza was first taken to a local clinic and then transferred to TMSS Medical College and Rafatullah Community Hospital in Bogura, where she died around 11:45 am.
The state minister sustained an injury to his right leg when the SUV swerved off the road and fell into a paddy field while attempting to avoid the woman.
The minister's wife also suffered minor injuries. Abdul Bari was initially treated at Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Medical College Hospital before being moved to Dhaka for advanced treatment.
Shibganj Police Station OC Shaheenuzzaman stated that no formal case has been filed regarding the accident and death, though a General Diary has been recorded.
The Shibganj Upazila Nirbahi Officer (UNO) provided Tk 25,000 to the victim’s family for burial expenses.
